title: C# Editor Features
description: Explore the enhanced C# editing features provided by this extension.

steps.title: Type Inlay Hints
steps.description:
The extension provides inlay hints that show the inferred types for var declarations directly in your code.

This makes it easier to understand what type a variable is without having to hover over it or navigate to its definition.

You can toggle type inlay hints:

1. Run the command **C# Solution Explorer: Toggle C# Type Inlay Hints** from the Command Palette
2. Enable/disable in settings with **csharp-dev-tools.inlayHints.enableTypeHints**

You can also customize the color of inlay hints using the color theme settings.

media.altText: C# code showing type inlay hints for var declarations

steps.title: Unused Symbol Highlighting
steps.description:
The extension can highlight unused properties and methods by reducing their opacity, making it easier to identify dead code.

You can toggle unused symbol highlighting:

1. Run the command **C# Solution Explorer: Toggle Unused Symbol Highlighting** from the Command Palette
2. Enable/disable in settings with **csharp-dev-tools.editor.highlightUnusedSymbols**

You can also adjust the opacity level of unused symbols in the settings.

media.altText: C# code showing unused methods with reduced opacity

steps.title: Code Navigation Enhancements
steps.description:
The extension enhances C# code navigation in several ways:

1. **Alt+P**: Quick access to the Advanced Search for finding types and members
2. **Shift+Alt+L**: Reveal the current file in Solution Explorer
3. **Context menu**: Additional options for opening files to the side and revealing in Explorer

These shortcuts make it easier to navigate large codebases.

media.altText: Code navigation features in the editor
